newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady to narrowly stronger.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady to narrowly stronger.

text.p: NWE gasoline was steady to marginally firmer on Monday after hefty gains last week.

Activity was slim, but was expected to pick up in the afternoon. Eurograde Rotterdam refinery barges were bids as high of $201.50 fob against offers of $203.50, but several dealers felt $200.00 was a realistic deal level.
The NEW market remains finely balanced with tight supply offset by muted buying.
August swaps were offered at $199.50, about 50 cents firmer with September pegged around $192.50.
Strong NYMEX futures continued to support the European market, as did firm MTBE prices. Arbitraging to the United States was not seen profitable, but was moving in that direction, traders said.

IOC has cancelled its tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of 87.15 octane leaded gasoline for delivery between August 10-14, but bearish pressure will be limited by news Turkey's Tupras bought 50,000 tonnes of gasoline for August 5-14 develivery following July 15 and 16 tenders.
